feedback: fresh graph for each candidate; warm then reset; zero initial feedback and chronological delayed controller feedback; state retained at updates
candidate_semantics: gain/matrix applied before candidate frame; asynchronous submission-before to active-after source cursors expanded +/-1; n+1 means after retained prefix
scope: offline update-aware numerical characterization; no tolerance, equivalence, deadline or foreign callback allocation claim

ordinary_process_allocations.scope: separate warmed/reset best-candidate public process! only; property/matrix preparation, diagnostics and feedback copies excluded

candidate_search.proof: prefix SSE before earliest matrix adoption lower-bounds every full candidate in that gain branch; prune only when prefix exceeds an actually evaluated full SSE upper bound plus Float64 summation guard; ties retained
candidate_search.ranking: Float64 squared-error sum, then maximum absolute error, nonidentical components and adoption indices
candidate_search.ranking_scope: global minimum Float64 SSE and its ties certified; runner-up/top remaining entries describe evaluated candidates only
candidate_search.margin_scope: roundoff protection only; no scientific error tolerance

no_update_counterfactual.scope: same recorded ADC inputs and feedback carried; original gain/matrix throughout; not a live plant trajectory
